headline: Victorian Government Approves 155-Turbine Wind Farm Ahead of Election
summary: A controversial 155-turbine wind farm has been approved in northern Victoria just one day before the state government enters caretaker mode.
why: Large-scale renewable energy project approvals dictate regional capital investments and clean energy infrastructure development capacity.

impacts.name: Renewable Energy Sector
impacts.why: Regulatory approval enables project advancement and capital deployment for wind energy developers.
